description:
Property Partners Gill & Glynn is delighted to present this beautifully maintained detached, dormer bungalow to the market. Located within walking distance to Clarinbridge and just 20 mins from Galway city and approx. 10 minutes from the M17/18 motorway it would be an ideal location for someone looking to live in a countryside setting yet stay connected to all local amenities. These amenities include schools, shops, pubs, churches & restaurants

ACCOMMODATION
Accommodation extends to 220.9 sqm. The property opens onto a large and welcoming hallway, to the left of which is a cosy living room. The decorative style throughout the property is contemporary, with a colour palette of bright neutrals. The living room features built in cabinetry and shelving on either side of the decorative mantlepiece. 

A large kitchen is located to the rear of the property, with white shaker-style cabinetry and traditional cup drawer pulls. The room is large enough to accommodate a combined kitchen and dining room layout. There is a secondary living area off the kitchen, which has currently been designated as a formal dining room. 

An ample-sized utility room with attached guest WC is also located off the kitchen. The ground floor accommodation is completed by a spacious bedroom, as well as a home office. 

The first-floor features plush carpet throughout and comprises three spacious bedrooms and a family bathroom. The master bedroom has a moody ensuite bathroom, with earth toned floor to ceiling tiles, built in cubby shelving and a floating vanity.

Externally, the property is situated on a 0.47 acre site. The property is set nicely back from the road, with a long drive, lined with young trees and green lawns to either side.

DIRECTIONS
Homes of this calibre, combining generous accommodation, beautifully landscaped grounds, exceptional privacy and a convenient location close to Kilcolgan, Clarinbridge and Galway City, rarely come to the market. This is a superb opportunity to acquire a substantial turnkey family home that offers space, quality and an outstanding lifestyle in one of South Galway`s most desirable residential settings.

This exceptional property is certain to appeal to families seeking a forever home where generous accommodation, beautifully maintained gardens and peaceful countryside surroundings combine with excellent accessibility to nearby amenities and Galway City. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this impressive residence has to offer.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
Property Partners Gill & Glynn strive to be flexible around viewings. To arrange an appointment, call, text or WhatsApp Emma Gill 091 884000 or 087 7999955.
